# Test fixtures

## `specification-pre-pdx01-ba93e21.html`

`specification.html` exactly as it stood at commit **`ba93e21`**, before PDX-01
was restored to it. At that revision the page named four controls — IDG-01,
DBC-01, EIT-01 and ATR-01 — and had grown a "Why These Four" section around the
omission.

It is committed here rather than fetched from git history because CI checks out
with `fetch-depth: 1`, so `git show ba93e21:specification.html` fails on the
runner. That made `test_guard_would_have_caught_the_original_defect` skip in CI
while passing locally — a test that only runs on the maintainer's machine is not
a regression guard, and it was the reason CI reported "1144 passed, 1 skipped"
under a job named "0 skipped".

Do not edit this file. Its value is that it is the real defect, unaltered.
